This change also impacts the logic in `gf_filter_post_process_task_internal`, where the condition for scheduling the next task is now based on the `in_process_callback` flag, ensuring that the scheduling logic behaves correctly when the filter is actively processing. Overall, these changes enhance the synchronization and state management of the filter processing tasks.
